RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so the panel's composition can't plausibly explain a decision between you. An all-woman panel is unremarkable in a field where women predominate, and raising it would weaken your credibility on the points that actually matter.

Those points are stronger. You have a formal request for written reasons outstanding for two weeks — follow up in writing, citing any statutory or policy deadline that applies where you work. Ask specifically how "broad leadership experience" and a management course were weighted against eight years of section leadership and a doctorate, and whether the criteria were set before applications were assessed. That's where a real problem, if any, will show up.
